verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 8 leads at a $223.26 CPL across $1,786.10 in total spend, with Google Ads leading investment at $1,113.97. performance.verdict: Six overdue milestones are throttling scale; intake gap is the core blocker.

findings.text: Booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31), intake owner confirmation (due 2026-08-31), Review Boost campaign, Financing page, and Homer Glen branch all overdue; LSA re-enable due 2026-09-01 now 8 days past.
28-day CPL is $223.26 on only 8 leads from $1,786 spend; 3-day lead signal (Sep 6–8: 0,1,1) vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5: 2,1,0) shows no improvement — volume is structurally anemic.
Google spend collapsed -39.23% week-over-week; last 3 days averaged $48.09/day vs $77.49 prior 3 days — sustained reduction, not a single-day anomaly.

GBP actions hit 0 for 9 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 8) after averaging 4.5/day earlier in the series — profile visibility has fully collapsed, contradicting the daily verdict's 'paused' framing; this looks like a ranking drop or listing issue.

GHL returned a 401 timeout error; pipeline data is unavailable. With intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7, speed-to-lead automation may be routing to an empty seat — any arriving leads are at risk of going unclaimed.

suggestions.text: Resolve GBP visibility collapse immediately; audit listing status and recent edits to restore 4.5 actions/day baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 9 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 8) after averaging 4.5/day earlier in the series — this is a confirmed sustained drop, not lag. Audit the listing for suspensions, ownership conflicts, or recent edits that may have triggered a review; check both the Crestwood and Fibid profiles without touching the Crestwood 145-review profile. Success = GBP actions return above 3/day within 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and test GHL login before any budget is raised; the scale-up gate is explicitly blocked by this gap.
suggestions.monday_update: Intake ownership has been unconfirmed since Vivian left on 7/7 — this is a hard SOW blocker (due 2026-08-31, now 9 days overdue) and directly gates any budget scale-up. Contact Xavier or Aiman to name the current intake owner, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is in place. Success = named owner confirmed in writing and GHL 401 error resolved. Must be closed before 2026-09-16 or budgets cannot responsibly increase.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL and Google spend daily for 3 more days before any budget move; current $223.26 CPL is too high to scale.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day CPL stands at $223.26 on just 8 leads, and Google spend dropped -39.23% week-over-week with the 3-day average falling to $48.09/day. No budget increase is defensible until the intake gap (F1/F5) is resolved and CPL trends downward from its current level. Re-check on 2026-09-12 with fresh 3-day signal; if CPL is still above $200 and intake is unresolved, escalate the SOW blockers to Nacer.
